title: fix: use python:3.11-slim base image for Docker build
body: ## Summary The `docker-build` CI job fails because `apache/spark-py:v3.5.1` doesn't exist on Docker Hub. Switch to `python:3.11-slim` + `openjdk-17-jre-headless` as the base image. PySpark is already installed via pip from `pyproject.toml`, so the only missing runtime dependency is a JRE for the Spark JVM layer. This makes the image smaller and removes the dependency on a third-party Spark image. Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/f8eb1354fd1541de89e5440932334799 Requested by: @jennamansueto ---
